name: Friends Club
title: Friends Club — Badminton in Prague for all levels
description: Friendly badminton sessions in Prague for all levels. Pick a date, join the poll, bring friends and check in with your Multisport card — or pay at the venue.

steps.title: Pick a date
steps.text: Glowing dates on the calendar have an open poll. Choose the session that suits you.

steps.title: Join in seconds
steps.text: Enter your name, add your Multisport card or choose to pay at the venue, and bring friends as guests.

steps.title: Scan in at the door
steps.text: Multisport players scan their card at the entrance and are checked in automatically.

faq.q: Who can join Friends Club badminton?
faq.a: Anyone who enjoys badminton — beginners and experienced players are all welcome. Pick a highlighted date on the calendar and join the poll.

faq.q: Do I need a Multisport card?
faq.a: No. If you have Multisport, add your card number when you join and scan it at the entrance. Without Multisport you simply pay at the venue.
Yes. Add guests when you join a session — they count towards the session's spots and pay at the venue.
At sports centres in Prague. Every session shows its venue and time, and the court numbers appear once they are booked.
Yes — open My sessions and leave the session up to 25 hours before it starts, so someone else can take your spot.
No account needed. Just enter your name when you join; your sessions are remembered on your phone.
